name: Ankle Pumps

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: AAOS Foot and Ankle Conditioning Program

steps: Sit or lie comfortably with your legs extended straight in front of you.
Point your toes and feet forward away from your body as far as possible, as if depressing a car accelerator pedal.
Hold for 1 second in full plantarflexion.
Pull your toes and feet backward toward your shins into full dorsiflexion.
Hold for 1 second in dorsiflexion, feeling the calf and shin muscles alternately engage.
Continue pumping rhythmically between pointing and flexing for the prescribed repetitions.
coaching_cues: Move strictly through your ankle joints while keeping your knees and hips still.
Perform smooth, rhythmic pumps to promote circulation and venous blood return.
Work through full available pain-free range of motion.

sources.attribution: AAOS Foot and Ankle Conditioning Program
